problem:
Consider the highlighted entry of the matrix $A$ given below. Describe it in terms of ${a}_{ij}.$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & 10 & 6 \\ 6 & 14 & 8 & 1 \\ 9 & 17 & 9 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution: The entry lies at the intersection of the $3$rd row and $4$th column. Hence, we have ${a}_{34}=0.$
